questionText:
Read the following special education and visual impairment case study and answer the questions that follow:

Anand, a 10-year-old student with congenital total blindness, is enrolled in Class 5 of an inclusive neighborhood school. The school management collaborates with a certified Vision Special Educator to establish an accessible learning environment:

2. ICT Assistive Technology: The computer lab installs JAWS and NVDA screen-reading software on computers, converting digital documents and internet websites into synthetic human speech via audio headphones.
3. Tactile and Sensory Learning: Geometry and geography lessons utilize raised-line tactile diagram kits, thermoform relief maps, and embossed abacuses (Taylor Frame).

options.text: Guiding students exclusively while holding their hands forever
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Applies an adjacent or reciprocal mathematical relation.

options.text: Training students to run Olympic track races without shoes
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Confuses related NCERT concepts or attributes.

O&M training imparts spatial orientation skills and cane travel techniques, enabling blind individuals to navigate environments safely and independently.

Therefore, option (B) is the correct answer.
